name: Gaze and Hand Region Selection
summary: Four ways to draw a rectangular selection region in AR without a mouse: pinch-and-drag, blink-to-blink with the eyes, or gaze drawing the rectangle while the hand starts and ends it.
howItWorks: The region is drawn from one corner to the opposite one in three steps: start, form, end. Pinch-Only: pinch, drag the hand (thumb position) and release. Eye-Only: blink (0.2 s) to pin the first corner, move the gaze, blink again. Gaze-Pinch: pinch while looking at the first corner, hold, look at the last corner and release. Gaze-Finger: dwell 0.8 s on the raised fingertip to start, draw with the gaze while keeping the finger at the region's depth, then withdraw the finger to end. Evaluated on HoloLens 2 (N=20) with regions 0.5 m away, some larger than the field of view: the unimodal Pinch-Only and Eye-Only were faster and preferred; Gaze-Finger gave the most accurate start point. Eye-Only was the most socially acceptable.

relationships.note: Gaze-Finger builds on the gaze-hand alignment principle.
